steps.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord, capture the protected dirty snapshot, and checkpoint INSPECTING. Read-only.

logs.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord and find the first actionable failure. Read-only; do not change the shared phase.

metadata.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord and prove relevant final metadata/append/task facts. Read-only; do not change the shared phase.

standards.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord and inspect only implicated files. Read-only; do not change the shared phase.

reducer.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord, merge diagnostic Evidence, define the immutable verification contract, and checkpoint PLANNING with an exact minimal fix plan. Do not approve unspecified content.

steps.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. For a repair after failed verification, call yocto_task_replan with its failed current-run Evidence before preparing a revised immutable ChangeSet. Apply only after exact human approval; if approval is unavailable, stop without edits.

Open the supplied TaskRecord. Checkpoint VERIFYING, execute every verificationReadiness requirement, and use the current loop number as verification iteration 1 or 2. Mark semantic assertion failures FAILED with their trusted Evidence so controlled replanning remains legal. Return done=true only when the persisted contract passes.

Open the supplied TaskRecord. Reconcile the evidence ledger, ChangeSet, approvals, jobs and verification results. Call yocto_completion_status and use yocto_task_finalize only if all requirements passed; otherwise request controlled replanning when eligible, checkpoint PAUSED when resumable, and use terminal FAILED only when no legal recovery remains.
